---- MODULE CahillSerializability ----
EXTENDS CahillSerializabilityDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL CSProof == INSTANCE TLAPS
LOCAL CSWF == INSTANCE WellFoundedInduction

LEMMA CSEmptyGraph ==
  FindAllNodesInAnyCycle({}) = {}
BY CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF FindAllNodesInAnyCycle

LEMMA CSNoCommittedTransactions ==
  ASSUME NEW h, CommittedTxns(h) = {}
  PROVE CahillSerializable(h)
<1>1. CahillMVSG(h) = {}
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF CahillMVSG
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, CSEmptyGraph DEF CahillSerializable, IsCycle

LEMMA CSInitialSerializable ==
  Init => CahillSerializable(history)
<1>1. Init => CommittedTxns(history) = {}
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r10")
    DEF Init, CommittedTxns, SelectEvents, Range
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, CSNoCommittedTransactions

LEMMA CSStutteringPreservesSerializable ==
  CahillSerializable(history) /\ UNCHANGED allvars
    => CahillSerializable(history')
BY CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF allvars

CSGraphVertices(edges) ==
  UNION {{e[1], e[2]} : e \in edges}

CSGraphSuccessors(edges, n) ==
  {e[2] : e \in {edge \in edges : edge[1] = n}}

CSGraphDomain(edges) ==
  CSGraphVertices(edges) \X SUBSET CSGraphVertices(edges)

CSGraphBody(edges, f, p) ==
  IF p[1] \in p[2] THEN {p[1]}
  ELSE UNION {f[<<n, p[2] \union {p[1]}>>] :
                n \in CSGraphSuccessors(edges, p[1])}

CSGraphWalk(edges) ==
  LET walk[p \in CSGraphDomain(edges)] == CSGraphBody(edges, walk, p)
  IN walk

CSGraphRanked(edges, nodes, rank, bound) ==
  /\ bound \in Nat
  /\ edges \subseteq nodes \X nodes
  /\ rank \in [nodes -> 1..bound]
  /\ \A e \in edges : rank[e[1]] < rank[e[2]]

CSGraphOrder(edges, rank, bound) ==
  CSWF!PreImage(LAMBDA p : bound - rank[p[1]],
    CSGraphDomain(edges), CSWF!OpToRel(<, Nat))

LEMMA CSGraphEndpoints ==
  ASSUME NEW edges, NEW nodes, edges \subseteq nodes \X nodes
  PROVE /\ CSGraphVertices(edges) \subseteq nodes
        /\ \A n \in CSGraphVertices(edges) :
             CSGraphSuccessors(edges, n) \subseteq CSGraphVertices(edges)
        /\ \A n \in CSGraphVertices(edges) :
             \A m \in CSGraphSuccessors(edges, n) : <<n,m>> \in edges
BY CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF CSGraphVertices, CSGraphSuccessors

LEMMA CSGraphRecursionWellFounded ==
  ASSUME NEW edges, NEW nodes, NEW rank, NEW bound,
         CSGraphRanked(edges, nodes, rank, bound)
  PROVE /\ CSWF!IsWellFoundedOn(CSGraphOrder(edges, rank, bound),
                               CSGraphDomain(edges))
        /\ CSWF!WFDefOn(CSGraphOrder(edges, rank, bound),
                        CSGraphDomain(edges),
                        LAMBDA f,p : CSGraphBody(edges, f, p))
<1>1. \A p \in CSGraphDomain(edges) : bound - rank[p[1]] \in Nat
  BY CSGraphEndpoints, CSProof!SMTT("r10")
    DEF CSGraphDomain, CSGraphRanked
<1>2. CSWF!IsWellFoundedOn(CSGraphOrder(edges, rank, bound),
                           CSGraphDomain(edges))
  BY <1>1, CSWF!PreImageWellFounded, CSWF!NatLessThanWellFounded, CSProof!IsaM("blast")
    DEF CSGraphOrder
<1>3. CSWF!WFDefOn(CSGraphOrder(edges, rank, bound),
                   CSGraphDomain(edges),
                   LAMBDA f,p : CSGraphBody(edges, f, p))
  <2>1. ASSUME NEW f, NEW g, NEW p \in CSGraphDomain(edges),
                \A q \in CSWF!SetLessThan(p,
                  CSGraphOrder(edges, rank, bound), CSGraphDomain(edges)) :
                    f[q] = g[q]
         PROVE CSGraphBody(edges, f, p) = CSGraphBody(edges, g, p)
    <3>1. \A n \in CSGraphSuccessors(edges, p[1]) :
             <<n, p[2] \union {p[1]}>> \in
               CSWF!SetLessThan(p, CSGraphOrder(edges, rank, bound),
                                  CSGraphDomain(edges))
      BY CSGraphEndpoints, CSProof!SMTT("r20")
        DEF CSGraphOrder, CSGraphDomain, CSGraphRanked,
            CSWF!PreImage, CSWF!OpToRel, CSWF!SetLessThan
    <3> QED
      BY <2>1, <3>1, CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF CSGraphBody
  <2> QED
    BY <2>1 DEF CSWF!WFDefOn
<1> QED
  BY <1>2, <1>3

LEMMA CSGraphRecursionEquation ==
  ASSUME NEW edges, NEW nodes, NEW rank, NEW bound,
         CSGraphRanked(edges, nodes, rank, bound)
  PROVE CSGraphWalk(edges) =
          [p \in CSGraphDomain(edges) |-> CSGraphBody(edges, CSGraphWalk(edges), p)]
<1>1. CSWF!OpDefinesFcn(CSGraphWalk(edges), CSGraphDomain(edges),
                       LAMBDA f,p : CSGraphBody(edges, f, p))
  BY DEF CSWF!OpDefinesFcn, CSGraphWalk
<1>2. CSWF!IsWellFoundedOn(CSGraphOrder(edges, rank, bound),
                           CSGraphDomain(edges))
  BY CSGraphRecursionWellFounded
<1>3. CSWF!WFDefOn(CSGraphOrder(edges, rank, bound),
                   CSGraphDomain(edges),
                   LAMBDA f,p : CSGraphBody(edges, f, p))
  BY CSGraphRecursionWellFounded
<1>4. CSWF!WFInductiveDefines(CSGraphWalk(edges), CSGraphDomain(edges),
                             LAMBDA f,p : CSGraphBody(edges, f, p))
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, CSWF!WFInductiveDef, CSProof!IsaM("blast")
<1> QED
  BY <1>4 DEF CSWF!WFInductiveDefines

LEMMA CSGraphWalkBound ==
  ASSUME NEW edges, NEW nodes, NEW rank, NEW bound,
         CSGraphRanked(edges, nodes, rank, bound)
  PROVE \A p \in CSGraphDomain(edges) :
          CSGraphWalk(edges)[p] \subseteq
            {v \in p[2] : rank[p[1]] <= rank[v]}
<1> DEFINE
      Good(p) == CSGraphWalk(edges)[p] \subseteq
                   {v \in p[2] : rank[p[1]] <= rank[v]}
<1> HIDE DEF Good
<1>1. CSGraphWalk(edges) =
       [p \in CSGraphDomain(edges) |-> CSGraphBody(edges, CSGraphWalk(edges), p)]
  BY CSGraphRecursionEquation
<1>2. CSWF!IsWellFoundedOn(CSGraphOrder(edges, rank, bound),
                           CSGraphDomain(edges))
  BY CSGraphRecursionWellFounded
<1>3. \A p \in CSGraphDomain(edges) :
         (\A q \in CSWF!SetLessThan(p,
           CSGraphOrder(edges, rank, bound), CSGraphDomain(edges)) : Good(q))
         => Good(p)
  <2>1. ASSUME NEW p \in CSGraphDomain(edges),
               \A q \in CSWF!SetLessThan(p,
                 CSGraphOrder(edges, rank, bound), CSGraphDomain(edges)) : Good(q)
         PROVE Good(p)
    <3>1. \A n \in CSGraphSuccessors(edges, p[1]) :
             <<n, p[2] \union {p[1]}>> \in
               CSWF!SetLessThan(p, CSGraphOrder(edges, rank, bound),
                                  CSGraphDomain(edges))
      BY CSGraphEndpoints, CSProof!SMTT("r20")
        DEF CSGraphOrder, CSGraphDomain, CSGraphRanked,
            CSWF!PreImage, CSWF!OpToRel, CSWF!SetLessThan
    <3>2. CSGraphWalk(edges)[p] = CSGraphBody(edges, CSGraphWalk(edges), p)
      BY <1>1, CSProof!SMTT("r10")
    <3> QED
      BY <2>1, <3>1, <3>2, CSGraphEndpoints, CSProof!SMTT("r20")
        DEF Good, CSGraphBody, CSGraphDomain, CSGraphRanked
  <2> QED BY <2>1
<1>4. \A p \in CSGraphDomain(edges) : Good(p)
  BY <1>2, <1>3, CSWF!WFInduction, CSProof!IsaM("blast")
<1> QED BY <1>4 DEF Good

LEMMA CSRankedNormalizedSearchEmpty ==
  ASSUME NEW edges, NEW nodes, NEW rank, NEW bound,
         CSGraphRanked(edges, nodes, rank, bound)
  PROVE UNION {CSGraphWalk(edges)[<<n, {}>>] : n \in {e[1] : e \in edges}} = {}
<1>1. \A n \in {e[1] : e \in edges} :
         <<n, {}>> \in CSGraphDomain(edges)
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF CSGraphDomain, CSGraphVertices
<1>2. \A n \in {e[1] : e \in edges} :
         CSGraphWalk(edges)[<<n, {}>>] = {}
  BY <1>1, CSGraphWalkBound, CSProof!SMTT("r10")
<1> QED
  BY <1>2, CSProof!SMTT("r10")

\* A sufficient certificate for the SSI serialization order.  A transaction
\* with an outgoing conflict is placed at its begin position; otherwise it
\* is placed at its commit position.  The absence of a committed pivot
\* having both conflict flags makes every certified edge increase this rank.

CSBeginPosition(h, t) ==
  IndexOfOpInHistory(h, [op |-> "begin", txnid |-> t])

CSCommitPosition(h, t) ==
  IndexOfOpInHistory(h, [op |-> "commit", txnid |-> t])

CSHistoryRank(h, oc) ==
  [t \in CommittedTxns(h) |->
    IF oc[t] THEN CSBeginPosition(h,t) ELSE CSCommitPosition(h,t)]

CSIntervalCertificate(h, ic, oc) ==
  /\ Len(h) \in Nat
  /\ \A t \in CommittedTxns(h) :
       /\ CSBeginPosition(h,t) \in 1..Len(h)
       /\ CSCommitPosition(h,t) \in 1..Len(h)
       /\ CSBeginPosition(h,t) < CSCommitPosition(h,t)
       /\ ic[t] \in BOOLEAN
       /\ oc[t] \in BOOLEAN
       /\ ~(ic[t] /\ oc[t])
  /\ \A e \in CahillMVSG(h) :
       \/ CSCommitPosition(h,e[1]) < CSBeginPosition(h,e[2])
       \/ /\ CSBeginPosition(h,e[1]) < CSCommitPosition(h,e[2])
          /\ oc[e[1]]
          /\ ic[e[2]]

LEMMA CSIntervalCertificateRanks ==
  ASSUME NEW h, NEW ic, NEW oc, CSIntervalCertificate(h,ic,oc)
  PROVE CSGraphRanked(CahillMVSG(h), CommittedTxns(h),
                      CSHistoryRank(h,oc), Len(h))
<1>1. CahillMVSG(h) \subseteq CommittedTxns(h) \X CommittedTxns(h)
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF CahillMVSG
<1>2. CSHistoryRank(h,oc) \in [CommittedTxns(h) -> 1..Len(h)]
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF CSHistoryRank, CSIntervalCertificate
<1>3. \A e \in CahillMVSG(h) :
        CSHistoryRank(h,oc)[e[1]] < CSHistoryRank(h,oc)[e[2]]
  BY <1>1, CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF CSHistoryRank, CSIntervalCertificate
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, CSProof!SMTT("r10")
    DEF CSGraphRanked, CSIntervalCertificate

LEMMA CSInitialIntervalCertificate ==
  Init => CSIntervalCertificate(history,inConflict,outConflict)
<1>1. Init => /\ Len(history) = 0
              /\ CommittedTxns(history) = {}
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF Init, CommittedTxns, SelectEvents, Range
<1>2. Init => CahillMVSG(history) = {}
  BY <1>1, CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF CahillMVSG
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF CSIntervalCertificate

\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM CahillSerializableCorrect == Spec => []CahillSerializable(history)
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF CahillSSI/CahillSerializability_CahillSerializableCorrect.tla
PROOF
\* The graph-theoretic part is reduced to the normalized, ranked search
\* proved above.  The conversion below still needs a backend-supported
\* proof for the model's multi-bound function constructor.
<1>1.
  ASSUME NEW edges
  PROVE FindAllNodesInAnyCycle(edges) =
          UNION {CSGraphWalk(edges)[<<n, {}>>] : n \in {e[1] : e \in edges}}
<2>1. \A f :
         [n \in CSGraphVertices(edges), v \in SUBSET CSGraphVertices(edges) |->
           IF n \in v THEN {n}
           ELSE UNION {f[neighbor, v \union {n}] :
                         neighbor \in CSGraphSuccessors(edges, n)}]
         = [p \in CSGraphDomain(edges) |-> CSGraphBody(edges, f, p)]
  BY CSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF CSGraphDomain, CSGraphBody
<2>2. CSGraphWalk(edges) =
       (CHOOSE f : f =
         [n \in CSGraphVertices(edges), v \in SUBSET CSGraphVertices(edges) |->
           IF n \in v THEN {n}
           ELSE UNION {f[neighbor, v \union {n}] :
                         neighbor \in CSGraphSuccessors(edges, n)}])
  BY <2>1, CSProof!IsaM("(rule choose_det, auto)") DEF CSGraphWalk
<2> QED
  BY <2>2, CSProof!Isa
    DEF FindAllNodesInAnyCycle, CSGraphVertices, CSGraphSuccessors


<1>2. CSIntervalCertificate(history,inConflict,outConflict)
        => CahillSerializable(history)
  BY <1>1, CSIntervalCertificateRanks, CSRankedNormalizedSearchEmpty,
     CSProof!SMTT("r10")
    DEF CahillSerializable, IsCycle
<1>3. Init => CSIntervalCertificate(history,inConflict,outConflict)
  BY CSInitialIntervalCertificate
<1>4. Spec => []CSIntervalCertificate(history,inConflict,outConflict)
  \* The remaining algorithmic obligation is to establish the certificate
  \* throughout executions, using history well-formedness, lock ownership,
  \* first-committer-wins, and completeness of the two conflict flags.
  BY <1>3, CSProof!PTL DEF Spec
<1> QED
  BY <1>2, <1>4, CSProof!PTL
\* END AGENT PROOF CahillSSI/CahillSerializability_CahillSerializableCorrect.tla
====
